dependency_stubs: _binding returns a synthetic SimpleNamespace plan with fixed hash c repeated 64 times and max_observations=10
_private_file, _database, _original, and _owner are no-op stubs; they do not verify path safety, inode identity, original-plan continuity, or cooperative lock ownership
_readonly maps fixed synthetic plan paths to per-case temporary read-only SQLite files
_capture, MarketCapture, quote_snapshot, UpstoxReads.normalize_snapshot, Calendar.require_instrument, and protection_allows_entry remain actual Python implementations
No credentials, sockets, network, original databases, or runtime archives are accessed

ledger_and_protection:
CREATE TABLE account (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), cash TEXT,
            initial TEXT, halted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE metadata (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE paper_entry_protection (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),value TEXT NOT NULL,config TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE paper_protection_jobs (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('CLAIMED','CAPTURED','DONE')), capture TEXT, result TEXT, result_hash TEXT)
CREATE TABLE paper_protection_profile (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), value TEXT NOT NULL, observations INTEGER NOT NULL, last_at TEXT)
market_archive: CREATE TABLE market_captures (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL)
